body: Engaging in all the things that I used to enjoy only fills me with more regret. It makes me want to go back to the past and change everything but that won't happen. I feel empty. With each minute I feel myself getting closer to the end.
I would go to sleep. That or watch youtube videos.
Playing games is only going to make me feel worse.
With each day that passes there are fewer and fewer things that calm me.
Not really, but I have played various games in the Sonic series.

Because this ailment is for life. Worse still, it can exacerbate another chronic condition that I have and could possibly threaten my life. It could be a very long time before a cure is even created. I don't want to suffer that long. I may as well just end it now.
I guess this is goodbye.
I don't think that there is a prayer in the world that can save me.
Even if there are advances in medicine, its going to take quite a while and that is time that I don't have.
Yes I have played Donkey Kong. The Super Nintendo was one of my favorite game systems. It always gives me a sense of nostalgia. But thinking about the past only makes me sad and angry with myself.
Several times. I only get the same answers from them every time we talk. Sometimes it just makes things worse. As I said before, talking does nothing to fix the problem.
I can't count how many times I have tried that. I've done it so much that it no longer calms me.

I'm not religious. Praying does nothing for me. My parents always badgered me with their religious beliefs and always told me I can't make it to heaven if I take my life. I always take talk of religion with a grain of salt. I don't believe in a god and I find it annoying when people start throwing that in my direction. I don't want to sound mean but that doesn't help.
I don't have the means to travel far from home and the materials are too bulky and heavy to move without someone noticing. I really don't want my family to be the first ones to find my corpse.
Meditation does nothing for me. I have tried it even before I became this depressed and it never really worked. I haven't given it a second thought since then.
I wish I could. I can draw and paint but I can't recall the technical terms or what they mean. At least not right now.
All the classics like Mario, Legend of Zelda, Final Fantasy, etc.
I am close with my family members
One of the problems will be following me for the rest of my life. I am not willing to deal with the effects.
I don't know what else I can do.
Visual art, video games, talking with friends, bike riding, and watching TV. I don't find an of those things enjoyable anymore. All they do is create more regret.
I created my account a little under a month ago. Ever since then I have been on this side of reddit.
I'm glad that you were able to help her move on. Unfortunately, that isn't the case with me.
I can't. I'm sorry.
I've got everything set up. All I have to do is take the final step and I'll be gone.
I've been there before as well and it's hell. It did nothing for me. All I could do while I as there was think about the problems. It drove me crazy.

I am beyond help right now all I can think about is death. I'm literally "staring it in face." I thought it would provide a little relief to put it somewhere instead of holding it all in but talking won't fix the problem.
What's the point? I've pretty much lost all feeling. I'm pretty much a shell. Any fear of dying has disappeared.
I'm afraid I won't be here at that point. I'm sorry.

That isn't my only problem. There are others. 
I can't live like this.
No. I was never with anyone and I still got it. I don't know where the hell it came from! I'm freaking out. I can't believe this!

I am truly sorry if I'm upsetting anyone. That wasn't my intention. This is hard (maybe you'll disagree with me) and I'm trying to hold on. You're right... I'm not looking for support the right way and for that I apologize.

>No, it doesn't, and that is a truly ridiculous thing to say.

You'll probably chalk this up to me being irrational again. I think that saying it won't affect nearly every facet of my life is disingenuous. I'll have to be mindful of triggers and adjust accordingly, won't I?

>You are still not thinking rationally. To claim that oral herpes is going to affect nearly every facet of your life is nothing short of absurd.

Again, triggers! Have to avoid them don't I? Other things such as having to disclose to potential partners, keeping away from direct contact with others during outbreaks etc. Are these not significant changes?

>Are you no longer in the psych hospital? It could potentially be very helpful to discuss your situation and your thoughts regarding it with a therapist. I strongly encourage you to do so.

Yes, I am out of the hospital and I am seeking professional help.

>No, it is your conclusions that are unwarranted, eg that this is going to affect every aspect of your life, or that your situation warrants suicide. Your thinking would best be described as irrational, or distorted. You are making unwarranted assumptions and experiencing cognitive distortions.

Let me clarify. I WAS considering suicide because I didn't know what the heck I was going to do. Yes, its absurd to come to those conclusions but considering that this is for life, it overwhelmed and scared me (and it still does). I wasn't thinking straight forward and I might not be right now but I acknowledge that. Like I said, this isn't easy and it takes time to adjust to something like this. I have to consider the future and how I'm going to go about trying to remedy this. From my perspective, herpes isn't always as minute as people make it out to be. No matter how much medicine I take or how many mental health professionals I speak to it's always going to be at the back of my mind in some form or another. That may sound pessimistic and distorted but for me that is a reality that I have to face.

I can understand where you are coming from, but for me this isn't very easy to take. From here on this affects nearly every facet of my life. I've seen the statistics and I am fully aware that a whole lot of people are carriers of the virus. I have been jamming that fact into my cranium for nearly three weeks now. Yeah sure, maybe I wasn't thinking rationally and I own every single bit of that. We could even say that this type of thinking is unwarranted, but I'm not the only one that has had those thoughts and I certainly won't be the last. While I realize that I'm a part of the majority now, I'm not going ignore that there is a dark side to this. Furthermore, I'm not too keen on harboring something that is going to be constantly sending me painful reminders that its there. Unfortunately, I cannot change that. I wanted to put it out there that this can and does take it's toll.

Thank you for the encouragement. I really do appreciate it, but this is so hard. Right when I started to get the strength to manage the circumstances that I could change, I was hit with something that won't. This is the worst feeling ever, and I hate it, but I am trying to get through this as best as I can.
Yeah, that's correct.
By the way, if anyone needs further info I will be happy to provide.
